vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Yara was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Mateo taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Leo has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Mateo passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Wyatt, Ivan, Kofi, Bartek and Sonny met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Wyatt, Ivan, Kofi, Bartek, Sonny are hurt.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Wyatt, Ivan, Kofi and Bartek met them at the door — 4 put down. Wyatt, Ivan, Kofi, Bartek are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Wyatt, Ivan, Kofi and Bartek met them at the door — 4 put down. Wyatt, Ivan, Kofi, Bartek are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wyatt just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wyatt just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Wyatt, Kofi, Bartek, Valeria and Leo met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 barely walked away. Wyatt, Kofi, Bartek, Valeria, Leo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Valeria just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yara just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Raj — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Raj chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Raj Patel, 50 — a Pharmacist. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kurumi just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kurumi met them at the door — 1 put down.
